chose: The zoom's frame: a region is shown with a margin of 24 CSS px of the picture around it, centred in the frame above the captions' band (4% edge), never enlarged past 1.25 frame pixels to a pixel of the picture, so the code stays sharp; the picture is clipped above the band, which stays the ground for the captions.
options: margin 24 px, at most 1.25 frame px per picture px, clipped above the captions (chosen)
fill the frame and let the captions draw over the picture
no cap on the zoom, which blurs a short region
gray: How close the zoom comes and how much of the card stays around a region is visible in every zoomed scene; nothing settles it.
undo: Change `margin`'s default, `MOST` and the `#room` clip in `compositions/screen-zoom/index.html`.
